effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The receiver gets vault shares (9SUSDCcore). The vault computes the share count from its stored totals, rounded down.
formats.shown: Deposit: the USDC amount, the share ticker 9SUSDCcore as a raw constant, and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the vault's stored totals decide it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The descriptor has only `Share ticker` (raw constant) and no share amount.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The intent can name the share token, for example "Deposit USDC for 9SUSDCcore shares".

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name the asset or the vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`; the code pulls USDC (`super._deposit(caller, receiver, assets, shares)`) and mints 9SUSDCcore shares.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC into 9Summits vault".

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault. The vault computes the amount from `shares` and its stored totals, rounded up.
The receiver gets exactly `shares` vault shares (9SUSDCcore).
formats.shown: Mint: deposit asset 'USDC' as a raw constant, the exact share amount, and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; it comes from vault totals.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. The descriptor shows only `Deposit asset` = "USDC" with no amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value exists. The intent should at least say that USDC is paid.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; the code pulls USDC from the caller in `_deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares)`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Buy 9Summits vault shares with USDC".

findings.title: mint labels the USDC ticker "Deposit asset" with no amount, so it reads like an amount field.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Pays with (amount set by vault)".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner` (the signer when owner is the signer). The share count is computed from stored totals, rounded up.
When owner is not the signer, the call spends the share allowance the owner gave the signer.
The receiver gets exactly `assets` USDC, withdrawn from Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact USDC amount, the recipient, and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);`

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" does not say that vault shares are burned to pay out USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`; the code burns the owner's shares in `super._withdraw(caller, receiver, owner, assets, shares)`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC from 9Summits vault".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner` (the signer when owner is the signer). When owner is not the signer, the call spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
The receiver gets USDC. The amount is computed from stored totals, rounded down, and has no minimum bound.
formats.shown: Redeem: the share amount, the recipient, and the owner. Nothing names USDC as the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets for the burned shares.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ...Floor); _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);`. The descriptor redeem fields are only `Shares to redeem`, `To` and `Owner`. The intent is "Redeem".
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` or change the intent to "Redeem vault shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem cannot show the USDC amount received, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. No calldata bound exists.
